title: Lightwell v0 product decisions
objective: Resolve and record product choices separately from engineering, prioritizing the minimal S0 image-loading skeleton and then the M1 non-destructive editor.
context_summary: Planning-only update, 2026-09-19. User now requires the first end-to-end build to be a cross-platform skeleton that loads an image with no editing tools. Previously agreed crop, export, persistence, live agents and Locate remain M1 follow-on requirements. TASK-001 preserves the ongoing interview; TASK-023 through TASK-034 track distinct choices and state when they are needed. Dependency-free ready decision tasks can be interviewed independently; future choices do not block S0. Implementation gates TASK-035 and TASK-064 check the specified answers and completion status via file links. No software has been implemented. Current owner instruction (2026-09-19) defers manual Windows/Linux verification and license reviews; existing platform and GPL decisions remain recorded. M1 choices are still awaiting answers. Architecture reaffirmed 2026-09-19: D19–D21 accept complete API coverage, a small shared core/module host and external loading regardless of built-in packaging. Optionality and performance splitting require evidence; TASK-033/034 retain only the unresolved use-case/lifecycle and performance choices. This update implements no software; the existing S0 viewer is tracked in the implementation plan. Owner subsequently adopted TASK-026–030 recommendations and supplied workflow priorities; those decision tasks are complete. History clarification 2026-09-19: the owner requires persistent navigable action history for every edit, with preview and restore at any point. TASK-028/030 remain completed; new TASK-070 resolves the remaining restore/navigation presentation policy before M1 gate TASK-064. On 2026-09-20 the owner answered “Append a restore action and retain all history (Recommended)”, completing TASK-070. Restore appends a semantic action; undo/redo navigation and new edits never delete retained historical states. Research reference 2026-09-20: docs/research/lightroom/README.md will inform later tool/performance choices; research TASK-072 in the implementation plan settles no owner decisions and adds no S0/M1 prerequisite.
